meta.description: Monad is not a social network; it is an engine for human dialogue with truth. The only reference: the Qur’an.
footer: The hero here is truth, not us. — Monad
home.title: Worthwhile dialogues
home.empty: No published dialogues in this period.
new.title: New dialogue
new.intro: Write your question—in whatever language you think in. Monad is in no hurry.
finish.prompt: Publish this dialogue for others to read, or keep it private?
published.notice: The dialogue is published. Now any seeker in the world can read it.
private.notice: The dialogue stayed private and is not shown to others.
gift.title: Gift to Monad
gift.p1: Monad is free and will remain free. You see no ads, no data is sold, and no forced subscriptions.
gift.p2: But every dialogue with Monad has a real cost. These costs are covered not by a company or advertiser, but by the voluntary gifts of people themselves. If Monad has been valuable to you and you are able, your gift keeps it alive for others.
gift.p3: A gift gives you no special privileges; no extra quota, no extra visibility. Here all are equal, and the hero is truth. A gift is simply a way to help keep this space.
gift.soon: Gifting will be available soon. Thank you for being with us on this path.

login.disclaimer: Signing in is optional. Monad works fully without signing in; it only lets you have a name and a private archive of your dialogues.
